description: For someone from outside the EU who lost their job in Finland: the end of the residence-permit grace period (3 months after the job ended, 6 for an EU Blue Card), the days left, a week-by-week plan, links to the Finnish Immigration Service (Migri), and open jobs in a chosen field that work in English (the ad names English and does not require Finnish or Swedish). Takes the last day of the job, the permit type and optionally a field from list_job_filters in English. General information, not legal advice; Migri confirms the exact deadline. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.
